title: Localised video editing: the LanPaint/H3 masked route hit a wall - evaluate models built for the job

detail: brief.md written: gathers six days of uncarded work from five archived handoffs (3b115282, 95148d83, 2e25fba7, cde47622, 6200d155), the settled decisions that must not be re-opened, the 2026-09-08 measurements that close the H3 masked route, and a three-way comparison of Capybara / Bernini-R / VOID for the next session
